basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Patna Project Clinician Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Patna (AIIMS Patna) has announced 2 vacancies for the Project Clinician post under a project-based engagement. Eligible candidates must apply by email and also submit a hard copy to the Research Division AIIMS Patna on or before 17 October 2026. The tenure of the assignment is purely on a contract basis for a period of 3 months. Applicants must possess an MBBS, MBBS with DGO, or MBBS with MD/MS in Obstetrics & Gynaecology or Community & Family Medicine. The notified pay for the post is Rs. 80,000 - 1,20,000 per month. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: Any one of the following: 1. MBBS degree from a recognized university or institution. 2. MBBS with Postgraduate Diploma in Obstetrics & Gynaecology (DGO) from a recognized university or institution. 3. MBBS with MD / MS in Obstetrics & Gynaecology or Community & Family Medicine from a recognized university or institution. Essential Criteria - 1: Registration with Medical Council of India (MCI) or State Medical Council is mandatory at the time of application. Essential Experience: Experience of working in peripheral health facilities, particularly in maternal health or related clinical services of working in a peripheral health facility. Additional clinical exposure in obstetric care, including antenatal and labor room management, will be preferred. Age Limit: 40 years as on the day of interview.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Patna Project Clinician Job Description
content_sections.text: Responsible for the continuous monitoring and real-time review of fetal monitoring tracings transmitted from peripheral health centers through the Central Monitoring System. Ensure prompt identification of abnormal patterns or technical issues in the tracings and initiate necessary communication with Project Assistants or local clinical teams for follow-up actions. Will be given shift-wise duty, including night shifts, to ensure uninterrupted supervision of incoming data round the clock. Serve as a key of contact for all clinical coordination and troubleshooting, maintaining consistent communication with the Project Assistants deployed at peripheral sites. Document all observed clinical concerns, follow-up actions, and system-related issues in a timely and organized manner. Support the central team in generating daily summaries, alerts, or incident reports as needed for effective project oversight. Collaborate with the PI / Co-Pi for referral decisions, intervention planning, or escalation of clinical events based on the monitored data. Additional tasks or duties as assigned by the Principal Investigator or Competent Authority within the scope of the study.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for AIIMS Patna Project Clinician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Clinician post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Patna Project Clinician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email and hard copy is 17-10-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential qualification required for the Project Clinician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree, MBBS with Postgraduate Diploma in Obstetrics & Gynaecology (DGO), or MBBS with MD / MS in Obstetrics & Gynaecology or Community & Family Medicine from a recognized university or institution, along with valid MCI or State Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for AIIMS Patna Project Clinician?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years as on the day of the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary offered for the Project Clinician position?
faq.answer: The emoluments range from INR 80,000 to INR 1,20,000 per month depending on the candidate's specific qualifications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the duration of the Project Clinician engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement is strictly on a contract basis for an initial period of 3 months.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates can send their applications by hard copy to the Research Division AIIMS Patna and also email the application in the attached format to [email protected] with a copy to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Where will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at AIIMS Patna, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending.
